notes: Open, removed, or extended states are treated as on; closed, installed, or retracted states are treated as off. The two paired upper cabinets are split into separate movable-door events as required, although some individual door motions occur between sampled frames and therefore have lower confidence.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a residential kitchen with consecutive manipulations of the refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and wall-cabinet doors, followed by lids or drawers on several countertop appliances.
